title: CVE-2026-40217 actively exploited: unprotected alternate channel in BerriAI LiteLLM
content_md:
CVE-2026-40217 is a critical, actively exploited flaw in BerriAI LiteLLM involving an unprotected alternate channel.

Original article: https://infonewscyber.fr/info/cve-2026-40217-activement-exploitee-berriai-litellm-canal-alternatif-n-2767467965fb5daa

CVE-2026-40217.evidence: CISA's November 18, 2026 KEV update lists CVE-2026-40217 based on evidence of active exploitation.
